objective: Transform eligible canonical fundamental comparisons into PIT-safe, sign-safe descriptive deltas without labels, scoring, or model training.

SYMMETRIC_CHANGE.zero_denominator_rule: If both values are exactly zero, emit 0.

forbidden_in_v1: Traditional percent change across zero/sign changes.
Market labels, event-decay targets, model fitting or promotion.
pit_rules: Effective availability is the current filing availability timestamp.
Current availability must not precede previous availability.
Only Phase 2A.5 eligibility-approved comparisons may be transformed.
